title: The US Treasury's FinCEN says it's investigating a cybersecurity incident that "resulted in unauthorized access to a limited subset of its systems" (Lauren Feiner/The Verge)
summary: Lauren Feiner / The Verge: The US Treasury's FinCEN says it's investigating a cybersecurity incident that “resulted in unauthorized access to a limited subset of its systems” — FinCEN's alert comes in the wake of a reported breach of unclassified information at US spy agencies, including the CIA.
